name: Snehasanthwanam
benefit:
1. Under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹2200/- is given to the bedridden Endosulfan victims.
   1. Financial assistance of ₹1700/- is given to such bedridden Endosulfan victims who are getting ₹300/- per month as a disability pension.
   1. All other Endosulfan victims are given ₹1200/- based on the list furnished by the District Collector.
   1. In addition to this, monthly assistance of ₹7
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Kerala State.
1. The applicant should be an Endosulfan victim.
